newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 Fully Releases on December 11!
newsitems.author: kiki
newsitems.contents: Path of Exile 2 launches as a fully free-to-play action RPG on December 11 (PST)! Get your blades ready! The full release will introduce the Duelist, a long-awaited class revealed in a new trailer during gamescom’s Opening Night Live in Cologne. Whether you’re a new or returning player, sign up at pathofexile2.com/register to receive the latest release news and updates, as well as unlock exclusive milestone rewards on the road to launch. We can’t wait to welcome you to the full release of Path of Exile 2 on December 11!

newsitems.title: Watch the New Path of Exile 2 Reveal at gamescom
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Tomorrow, August 25 PDT, we’ll have an exclusive Path of Exile 2 reveal at gamescom 2026. Make sure to tune in to the gamescom stream to watch it live. If you can’t make it, we’ll also be posting the reveal on our social channels shortly after, so you won’t miss out! gamescom ONL kicks off on August 25 at 11:00 AM PDT, or Aug 26, 2026 6:00 AM (GMT+12) in your local time. If you’re attending gamescom, make sure to stop by our booth for an exclusive hands-on experience featuring the revealed content! You can find us in Hall 6.1, Booth B031.

newsitems.title: GGG Live on 27 August
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: On August 27 PDT, we’ll preview some new information about Path of Exile 2 and 0.5.5! Watch the livestream at 12:30 PM August 27 PDT at https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile. After that, we'll have a short Q&A session with Game Director Jonathan Rogers and ZiggyD, followed by the final ExileCon qualifier, so get ready! As per usual, co-streaming is welcome. See you soon!

newsitems.title: Path of Exile 2 ExileCon Qualifier #3 Is Going On Now!
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: The ExileCon Path of Exile 2 Qualifier #3 is happening now! Who will join Jiluo and Giuygiuyg in the finale at ExileCon this November? Watch the action live at https://www.twitch.tv/pathofexile! Co-streaming is welcome. Twitch Drops are now available for 24 hours, until 2 PM PDT on August 21. Watch the official broadcast or any channel streaming Path of Exile 2 for 30 minutes during the race, or catch up with your favourite content creator afterwards, to receive the Coliseum Helmet Attachment. For more details about the event, check out the announcement here. Good luck to all participants!

newsitems.title: The Last of the Druids Microtransactions Are Now Available in Store
newsitems.author: Natalia_GGG
newsitems.contents: Microtransactions from the Last of the Druids Mystery Box have finally been released in the store for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2! From Armour Sets to Portals and Level-Up Effects, there are over 60 new microtransactions available, giving you even more ways to customise your Exile and show off your style. Check out the full selection in the store, or watch the video below to take a closer look at everything included in the Last of the Druids Mystery Box. Thank you for your support!
